For a persisted source-only alternative, require operations=[] and assumptions=[], exact current case identity/incarnation/version, exact C08 request/result/envelope and alternative matching, full source identity/version/projection digest, and exact basis/assessment from canonical stored-scenario and case-coverage readers. Do not promote its hypothetical C08 coverage into source coverage or fall back to pending after a source-only authentication failure.

Compose the own criterion metric with real comparePlannerPreview, routed sources, canonical stored scenarios and a separate real Planner simulation without criteria. Keep the phase units issuer and actual rule registry. Initial unknown must arise from conditioned -30000, not stale bootstrap metric-unavailable.

After source/evidence/host callbacks, compare one final joint case+C08 snapshot and full detached digests. Synchronous requestFor identity, binding, request selector and abort-signal checks fence the return.
